stem:
Pallavi notes the Moon's place in the sky from her balcony at 8:30 p.m. on Friday. She checks again at 8:30 p.m. on Saturday.

What should she expect?

options.text: The Moon will be in exactly the same place in the sky both nights.
The Moon will most likely appear in a different part of the sky.
The Moon must rise exactly when the Sun sets on both nights.
The Moon's sky place never changes from one day to the next at the same clock time.

teacher.key_rationale: The Moon's place in the sky changes from one day to the next at the same clock time.
